facts.premium: Education-centred central Isan province; ~88% informal, student economy aside.
facts.skill_gap: Two large universities produce graduates who mostly leave; local jobs stay low-skill.
anchors: Universities (Mahasarakham U., RMU) — a large student economy
workers: Rice and cassava farmers and farm labour
Informal vendors, landlords and gig riders
impacts: University populations support steady rental, retail and food-trade income.
Rural income hinges on the monsoon harvest.
Cassava income pressured by sharp YoY price falls.
Skilled youth leave for Bangkok; local cash flow leans on remittances.
